3.2.2.4.4 The current status for all devices shall be maintained at each controller unit.
3.2.2.4.5 Alarms
Check Device Status for Alarm Condition
Each status received from device sensors shall be checked against alarm conditions for that device sensor and the status will be updated to indicate an alarm.
3.2.2.4.6 Critical alarms shall be generated when one or more of these conditions are met.
1) A closure device changes from a known state to unknown state (status lost)
2) A closure device changes from legal state to illegal state. E.g. pop-ups in the down position when they are supposed to be up.
3) The control system Integrity verification indicates a verification failure.

It sends “Device and Security Data” to “Data Processing and Security 3.2.4” and outputs “Commands” (via dashed line) to “HOV Field Devices”.

- **Data Processing and Security 3.2.4** receives “RLCS Data” from both “COTS Reporting 3.2.5” and “GUI 3.2.1”, and “Status and Event Data” from “Process Control & Monitoring 3.2.2”. It sends “Macro Commands” to “Sequencing 3.2.3” and “Current System Status” to “External Data Store” (represented by a computer icon).

- **Sequencing 3.2.3** receives “Macro Commands” from “Data Processing and Security 3.2.4” and sends “Macro commands/Sequencing” to “GUI 3.2.1”.

- **COTS Reporting 3.2.5** receives “RLCS Data” from “Data Processing and Security 3.2.4” and generates reports sent to “Traffic Operations Program Mgmt.

” These reports include: “Current Command Sum’ry”, “Event Log”, “Current System Status”, “Schedule”, “Failure Summary”, “Other Management Reports”, and “PIER Report”.

External entities and stores:

- **Traveling Public**, represented by a van labeled “CarPool”, interacts with the system through “HOV Field Devices”, which send “Status” to “Process Control & Monitoring 3.2.2” and receive “Commands” (dashed line) from it.

- **External Data Store** (computer icon) receives “Current System Status” from “Data Processing and Security 3.2.4”.

Management and operations interfaces:

- **Traffic Operations Program Mgmt.** receives report outputs from “COTS Reporting 3.2.5”.

- **RLCS Operations & Maint.** receives “RLCS Data” from “GUI 3.2.1”.
